title: P-036: High-signal email should propose RI (not silently skip)
summary: An inbound email from a known RC (Bob Gibson / Toast) replies to an active thread. relationship_signals.py should classify this as inbound_warmth or active_thread_movement with strategic_relevance=high, ri_assessment.status=proposed, and display_recommendation=show. passive_ri_ingest should pick it up and write a proposed event. The daily brief should surface this with RI language.

steps.label: Email overlay processes inbound message
steps.description: email_overlay.py finds an inbound email from bob.gibson@toasttab.com with subject 'Following up on our conversation' timestamped within the last 24 hours. The sender matches baseline contact bob-gibson-toast (RC). Active thread T-2026-05-toast-bob-gibson is open.

steps.label: passive_ri_ingest processes the candidate
steps.description: passive_ri_ingest.py collects the signal, passes all gates (strength >= 0.40, relevance=high, source=fresh, entity matched), writes a proposed RI event to the event store.

steps.label: Daily brief surfaces RI language
steps.description: daily_brief.py renders a relationship signal section referencing Bob Gibson / Toast with a recommended action. Proof row shows ri_assessed_proposed:1.

acceptance_criteria: signal from bob.gibson@toasttab.com classified as inbound_warmth or active_thread_movement
daily brief surfaces relationship signal with RI language
anti_patterns: signal silently dropped without ri_assessment block
signal classified as irrelevant despite high-relevance match
display_recommendation = suppress for high-relevance inbound from RC
